content: cargo-fuzz init creates a fuzz/ subdirectory beside src/ containing its own Cargo project depending on the parent crate by path, with fuzz_targets/*.rs using libfuzzer-sys. The fuzz dir can be part of the existing workspace (default) or an independent workspace (adding an empty [workspace] table to fuzz/Cargo.toml). Everything in the fuzz crate's dependency tree is compiled with --cfg fuzzing so expensive checks can be disabled. libfuzzer-sys is licensed '(MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND NCSA', so it needs an explicit cargo-deny allow entry unless the fuzz crate is kept out of the root workspace.
